description: Cropped paragraph from a serif-typeset news article — matching the New York Times' December 2016 report on the DNC hack — describing how, after the breach was discovered, ‘a secret committee was immediately created’ including Ms. Dacey, Ms. Wasserman Schultz, Mr. Brown and Michael Sussmann of Perkins Coie. Red boxes highlight ‘A secret committee was immediately created,’ ‘Michael Sussmann,’ and ‘who now works at Perkins Coie’.
text: No one knew just how bad the breach was — but it was clear that a lot more than a single filing cabinet worth of materials might have been taken. A secret committee was immediately created, including Ms. Dacey, Ms. Wasserman Schultz, Mr. Brown and Michael Sussmann, a former cybercrimes prosecutor at the Department of Justice who now works at Perkins Coie, the Washington law firm that handles D.N.C. political matters.
flags: Source attribution to the NYT 'Perfect Weapon' article inferred from typography and content; 'Mr. Brown' (DNC tech director Andrew Brown) named only by surname in the crop

description: Photograph of a Russian Navy nuclear attack submarine moored at a snowy Arctic pier, hull and sail dusted with snow, flying the St. Andrew's naval ensign on the sail and the Russian naval jack at the bow, with low snow-covered hills behind. The tall rounded sail and hull form are consistent with a Yasen-class (Project 885) boat such as K-560 Severodvinsk; the filename ‘REDOCTOBER2’ ties it to Q's recurring ‘Red October’ references.
flags: Class identification is consistent-with, not confirmed by hull markings; location inferred from terrain

The bottom caption claims Trump received the award ‘for contributing to the conditions of inner city black youths, standing alongside Muhammad Ali and Rosa Parks.’ Watermark @viralworldUSA.
text: WHY DOESN'T THE MEDIA REMEMBER THIS? @viralworldUSA. TRUMP BEING GIVEN THE ELLIS ISLAND AWARD FOR CONTRIBUTING TO THE CONDITIONS OF INNER CITY BLACK YOUTHS, STANDING ALONGSIDE MUHAMMAD ALI AND ROSA PARKS.
